title: Shaman King
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Yoh Asakura, a laid-back shaman able to commune with the dead, trains under his fiancee Anna to compete in the Shaman Fight, a tournament held every 500 years to choose the Shaman King who can channel the Great Spirit. He befriends rival shamans while facing his twin brother Hao, a reincarnated shaman who plans to wipe out humanity, and the X-Laws, a group devoted to killing Hao. This entry is the complete (kanzenban) edition with extra chapters.
life_message: Friendship, patience and understanding, rather than hatred, are what can change the world.

content.note: Tournament battles between shamans and a villain who plans to eradicate humans (Wikipedia); MangaUpdates tags tournaments, skeletons and necromancers.
Ghosts, the dead and souls absorbed into the Great Spirit (Wikipedia); AniList Ghost tag.
Engaged couple Yoh and Anna; romantic subplot (MangaUpdates).
Grief over Hao's mother drives his hatred (Wikipedia).
Contacting spirits of the dead is the premise.

folkways.japan: Draws on Japanese spirit beliefs (Izumo, ancestor spirits) and Buddhist imagery mixed with world religions, a common syncretic approach in Japanese media.

delivery.note: Hao's misanthropy is given a grieving motive and he postpones his plan rather than being destroyed.

winners_losers: Yoh and friends stop Hao without killing him; Hao is persuaded to observe humanity instead; forgiveness wins sympathy over vengeance.
